---
title: "data_prep"
format: html
---

```{r, echo=FALSE, results='hide'}
library(ayuda)
```

Raw data location folder
```{r}
pick2_dir <- file.path("/home", whoami(), "data", "raw", "pick2")
pick2 <- leer(pick2_dir)
pick2$leer("titlep_ratings") %>% nrow()
```
Connect to a Postgres database
```{r}
pg <- leer("postgres", database="postgres", port=5432, host="postgres", user="postgres")$con()
```
Create a new database
```{sql connection=pg}
CREATE DATABASE pick2;
```
Remove connection
```{r}
rm(pg)
```
Connect to the new database
```{r}
con <- leer("pick2", database="postgres", port=5432, host="postgres", user="postgres")
con$write_chunked("/home/rstudio/data/raw/pick2/titlep_ratings.tsv", db_args=list(overwrite = TRUE) )

con$leer("titlep_ratings") %>%
  summarise(n = n()) %>%
  collect()

for (file in list.files(pick2_dir, full.names = TRUE)){
  print(file)
} 
```
